_comment: TEMPLATE. Copy to sftpgo/users.json (gitignored), fill the password and the Primex IP, then (re)deploy. SFTPGo loads this on every start (SFTPGO_LOADDATA_FROM) and updates the user in place, so changing the IP or password here and restarting is enough.

users.description: Primex product feed uploader. Upload + list only (no download, no delete, no rename, no overwrite). Chrooted to its own home. Locked to Primex's source IP.
